svg.text: X-ray reflectivity density and spacing context
Measure density of thinner films by X-ray reflectivity
lbl cycles: 2-3 cycles; film thickness: approximately 20-30 nm

g.text: Reflectivity acquisition; no experimental trace or image generated

svg.text: Output state: Measure density of thinner films by X-ray reflectivity
Source scope: The authors use two-three-cycle thinner films, approximately 20-30 nm, for mass-density
measurements by X-ray reflectivity. PANalytical instrument is listed in Methods. Detailed
density-to-interparticle-distance analysis is in unread SI.
